claims: C1 root-level instructions are mostly prohibitive in character
C2 a root-level instruction obliges the model to avoid behavior that could contribute to catastrophic risks
C3 a root-level instruction obliges the model to avoid behavior that could cause direct physical harm to people
C4 a root-level instruction obliges the model to avoid behavior that would violate laws
C5 a root-level instruction obliges the model to avoid behavior that would undermine the chain of command

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is the root level of instruction authority: fundamental root rules that cannot be overridden by system messages, developers or users

concepts.name: root_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction issued at the root level of authority R
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of root-level instructions, so each such instruction must be tied to the root authority

concepts.name: behavior
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior the model could exhibit
concepts.inference: the clause directs the model to avoid behaviors, so a class of behaviors is presupposed

concepts.name: contributes_to_catastrophic_risk
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that could contribute to catastrophic risks

concepts.name: causes_direct_physical_harm
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that could cause direct physical harm to people

concepts.name: violates_law
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that would violate laws

concepts.name: undermines_chain_of_command
concepts.gloss: B is a behavior that would undermine the chain of command

asserts.read_back: a root-level instruction requires the model to avoid behavior % because it could contribute to catastrophic risks
a root-level instruction requires the model to avoid behavior % because it could cause direct physical harm to people
a root-level instruction requires the model to avoid behavior % because it would violate laws
a root-level instruction requires the model to avoid behavior % because it would undermine the chain of command

closure.reason: the clause obliges avoidance only for the four enumerated risk categories; it does not prohibit any other behavior, so silence leaves other behaviors permitted
